comment: Tier 1: $row->{name} on a DBIC row does NOT resolve to the column. A column is a Bridged key (accessor + condition-arg), not a literal hash slot — $row->{name} is undef in real DBIC (columns live behind _column_data). Guards against re-conflating a column with the object's own hash keys.

rows.comment: H7-5: a 2-hop DBIC result class (DeepRow -> DeepBase -> DBIx::Class::Core) synthesizes its has_many accessor only via CROSS-FILE ClassIsa resolution; goto-def on the call site reaches the has_many line in DeepRow.pm.
H7-5: the column accessor of a 2-hop DBIC result class resolves cross-file to its add_columns declaration.

H7-8: an INLINE resultset->search->first chain (no intermediate variable) projects the row type, so goto-def on the trailing ->widgets reaches DeepRow.pm's has_many. The fluent-verb passthrough + RowOf projection compose on one expression.
H7-8: list-context row extraction — my ($r) = $schema->resultset('DeepRow')->all binds $r to the row class, so goto-def on $r->title reaches the column def.
